title: 15th Annual Pershing Square Value Investing and Philanthropy Challenge
summary: The speaker argues that PayPal is a high-quality compounder with a wide moat that has been unfairly punished, offering a compelling buy opportunity with significant upside potential. They also highlight CARG as an undervalued online automotive marketplace with strong network effects, high margins, and transformative growth driven by its Car Offer platform. Additionally, the discussion touches on Google as a premium business needing to replace growth and briefly mentions Medtronic's competitor Tandem Diabetes Care.
thesis: The speaker argues that PayPal is a high-quality compounder with a wide moat that has been unfairly punished, offering a compelling buy opportunity with significant upside potential. They also highlight CARG as an undervalued online automotive marketplace with strong network effects, high margins, and transformative growth driven by its Car Offer platform. Additionally, the discussion touches on Google as a premium business needing to replace growth and briefly mentions Medtronic's competitor Tandem Diabetes Care.

claims.quote: relatively paypal is still gaining market share because there's such a huge green field like e-commerce market within us is growing 13 and a half percent keger whereas paypal is growing 20 20 high teens percent kicker so paypal is taking market share

claims.claim: PayPal's revenue excluding eBay is growing due to higher customer engagement, with transactions per account up 19% annually.
claims.quote: one thing that i might highlight about it that maybe goes back to the question about our revenue growth excluding ebay which is rolling off transactions per account on an annualized basis we're up about 19 historically that growth rate has been closer to yeah we have it right there nine percent so that's an early sign that this engagement program is working

claims.claim: The stock popped 11% after earnings despite grim numbers because expectations were low, similar to Facebook's reaction.
claims.quote: i just quickly pulled it up um is it was a horrible quarter um earnings operating cash flow free cash flow down 28 to 32 percent um they took down guidance for the year from from 470 to 390. so had you told me that i always said okay the stock's down another 20 today instead it's up 11 which sort of reminds me of what facebook did today

claims.claim: The speaker views PayPal as a high-quality compounder with a deep moat that has been unfairly punished by the market, creating an attractive opportunity to buy.
claims.quote: we think that shifting customer acquisition increased engagement venmo modernization improving margins and capital return potential backstop a very attractive fundamental outlook for paypal for years to come the stock has been unfairly punished by the market which we think creates a very exciting opportunity to buy into a high quality compounder with a deep moat that's very durable

claims.claim: The speaker proposes a 2027 price target of $285 for Tandem Diabetes Care, implying a bullish investment thesis based on market expansion and share gains.
claims.quote: today along with my colleagues mike dunleavy and jeremy miles we're going to pitch to you our investment thesis on tandem diabetes care the stock is currently trading at 101 dollars and we are proposing a 2027 price target of 285 dollars for an irr of twenty percent
claims.speaker: Jason Lay

claims.claim: The speaker suggests Medtronic is losing market share to Tandem due to neglected product development and issues with their new pump.
claims.quote: there are hiccups continued hiccups and medtronic in terms of issues with the new pump and the fda um the fact that cgm's continuously just don't work very well we think they're going to keep being a shared donor to its competitors mainly tandem
claims.speaker: Jason Lay

claims.claim: The speaker notes that Tandem's best-in-class performance is tied to Dexcom's CGM sensors, specifically the G6 and upcoming G7.
claims.quote: it has the best performance in terms of time and closed loops that time in range performance that we care about is the best in the market and it's tied to the best cgm sensor which is basically that glucose monitor which is produced by dexcom g6 and the g7 is going to be even better
claims.speaker: Jason Lay

claims.claim: The speaker believes Tandem can win due to having the best product, competitors donating share, and promising new product pipelines.
claims.quote: so now that we've established that this market is going to grow we think tandem can win and for three main reasons first we think he has the best product on the market technically speaking there are hiccups continued hiccups and medtronic in terms of issues with the new pump
claims.speaker: Jason Lay

claims.claim: The speaker states that Tandem's Control IQ technology was approved in Germany and France, serving as a catalyst for international growth.
claims.quote: furthermore tandem's control iq technology was just approved in some of its largest os markets including germany and france which we believe is another catalyst for international growth
claims.speaker: Jason Lay

claims.claim: The speaker projects that Tandem will hit a goal of 1 million users by 2027 based on primary research with endocrinologists and patient organizations.
claims.quote: so they've set what's been described as a lofty goal by the sell side of 1 million users by 2027 and our base case assumes that they're going to hit that we came to that conclusion through a series of primary research calls we did with endocrinologists patient organizations and other health associations across the country
